implementation.name: original-v3-streaming-cancellation
implementation.scope: Two separate outcomes on the original stream/parser/cancellation diagram. The source example rejects token 96 under a 4,096-token allowance. Up to 4,000 later steps can be avoided only when cancellation is honored. Partial proposals never reach a tool.
implementation.question: What does local rejection stop—and what needs provider cooperation?

purpose: Separate immediate local refusal from conditional provider stop and later KV release.
guard: A cancel request is not proof of cancellation. Remote KV may be reclaimed only when its consumers have stopped. No latency or realized saving is inferred from token allowance. The two cases are alternatives, not successive outcomes for one request.
